svg.title: B1.05 · Type Of Triangle
svg.desc: One label per input triple of sides. For 13, 14 and 30, the sum of the two shorter sides is 27. That row cannot form a triangle. 20,20,20 is Equilateral and 20,21,22 is Scalene. The valid 20,20,23 still needs the two-equal label. 20,20,23 is Isosceles. The result has one label for each of the four input triples. The example follows input order. FROM TRIANGLES · one table is enough. The three sides on one input row describe one candidate triangle. Testing A, B and C on that same row produces exactly one label for the triple.
svg.text: BOSSCODER 1.05 / SQL WALKTHROUGH
Type Of Triangle
One label per input triple of sides.
PREDICT THE RESULT
Why must the 13, 14, 30 row face the triangle test before its side lengths get classified?
Sample inputs
A triangle marks an example to follow. A dark source band spans its columns. ƒ marks a calculated value. Deeper cell colors mark the values to
follow. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
TRIANGLES · 4 rows
STEP 1
4 → 4 rows
Which triples can form a triangle?

g.aria-label: FROM TRIANGLES · one table is enough
g.text: FROM TRIANGLES · one table is enough
The three sides on one input row describe one candidate triangle. Testing A, B and C on that same row produces
exactly one label for the triple.

svg.text: For 13, 14 and 30, the sum of the two shorter sides is 27. That row cannot form a triangle.
WHEN A + B <= C OR A + C <= B OR B + C <= A
STEP 2
4 → 4 rows
Which valid triples are all equal or all different?
20,20,20 is Equilateral and 20,21,22 is Scalene. The valid 20,20,23 still needs the two-equal label.
WHEN A = B AND B = C … / WHEN A != B AND B != C AND C != A …
FINAL RESULT
4 → 4 rows
Which label belongs to each original row?
20,20,23 is Isosceles. The result has one label for each of the four input triples. The example follows input order.
CASE … THEN 'Isosceles' END AS TriangleType
